title: Understanding the hippocampus as an apex of the cortical hierarchy and self-supervised predictive learning engine
title_zh: 将海马理解为皮层层级顶点及自监督预测学习引擎
abstract: The mammalian cortex is organized along hierarchical gradients that extend from primary sensory regions to transmodal association networks. Converging neuroanatomical theory and data-driven analyses place the hippocampus at the apex of this hierarchy, where its subregional organization mirrors large-scale cortical networks and their evolutionary expansion. Building on these observations, we propose that the hippocampus functions as a predictive learning engine, generating latent training signals that support cortical learning. This view aligns with self-supervised machine learning frameworks, in which predictive processes occupy the top of hierarchical models. We suggest that hippocampal predictive learning constitutes a foundational mechanism of mammalian intelligence, linking cortical organization with principles underlying modern artificial systems.
abstract_zh: 哺乳动物皮层沿着从初级感觉区到多模态联合网络的层级梯度组织。整合神经解剖理论与数据驱动分析的结果将海马定位于该层级的顶点，其亚区结构镜像了大尺度皮层网络及其进化扩展。基于这些观察，我们提出海马作为一个预测学习引擎的功能模型，产生潜在训练信号以支持皮层学习。这一观点与自监督机器学习框架一致，在该框架中预测过程位于分层模型顶部。我们认为海马的预测学习构成了哺乳动物智能的一项基础机制，将皮层组织与现代人工系统的基本原理连接起来。
